I noticed he spends a majority of the video saying that if they cherry pick, then you should cherry pick back as well. Here is the thing though, all you have to do is point out the truth instead of blatantly cherry picking random stuff as a counter argument or to try and stump them.

He uses a lot of Old Testament verses as examples, however the Old Testament is not followed for its rules such as in Deuteronomy. For example, Hebrews 8:13 states that the new covenant Jesus made (which is referenced in the Old Testament) makes the old covenant God made with his people in the Old Testament obsolete. The only reason that the laws are still in the Bible is most likely for historical purposes (recorded history of how they did things for example).

Also, scripture specifically mentions multiple times that sexual immorality (including homosexuality) is wrong and that anyone who claims to follow Christ but does not stop their sexually immoral (1 Corithians 5:11 expands this to other things such as greed, swindling, etc.) ways should be removed from the church. Examples of this are Ephesians 5:3, Thessalonians 3:6, 1 Corinthians 5:11, and a few other verses.

Even though it is wrong for Christians to be sexually immoral (including homosexuality), this does not mean that Christians can judge others who do not believe or claim to be part of the faith. 1 Corinthians 5:12 and John 12:47 are both solid examples of this. If you want to call them out on wrongdoings, point this out when they persecute or judge others outside the faith, but there is a reason why they believe they should not be part of the church.

To wrap up, I did not get to even half the stuff he mentioned in this video, but he blatantly is misusing verses out of context, or is using jumps of logic as a proposed counter-arguement. For example, Deuteronomy 23:1 (ESV) says “No one whose testicles are crushed or whose male organ is cut off shall enter the assembly of the Lord.” Circumcision is not wounding the male organ, and it is in no way relatable to what this verse is talking about. To be honest, I see the point he tried to make but the way he tried arguing by misusing and twisting scripture out of context to fit his own argument is just as hypocritical as the ones who he was calling out.
